title.zh: 基础设施保护（受保护场所）（第 15 号）命令 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Places) (No. 15) Order 2020 and comes into operation on 6 November 2020.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected place

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the protected place.

3.—(1) Items (40) and (41) of the Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order (O 2) are deleted.
(2) Item (6) of the Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order (O 4) is deleted.
(3) Items (5) and (6) of the Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order (O 5) are deleted.
(4) Item (5) of the Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order (O 10) is deleted.
(5) Item (1) of the Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order (O 13) is deleted.
(6) The Protected Places (No. 12) Order 2003 (G.N. No. S 690/2003) is revoked.
